summary: Decode the gateway password with oc get secret/example-admin-password -o jsonpath={.data.password} | base64 --decode.
questions: How do I decode the AAP admin password?
Get the plain-text platform gateway password

answer_card.title: Get the admin password
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc get secret/<instance>-admin-password -o jsonpath={.data.password} | base64 --decode
```
The secret is `<instance>-<admin_user>-password`; `admin_user` defaults to `admin`.
